title: MJS M&A Partners reports unauthorized access to its network; data of up to several thousand clients and partners may have leaked
date_note: Date is the day MJS M&A Partners published its notice; the company says it found suspicious settings on a firewall device on 6 November and reported to the Personal Information Protection Commission on 12 November.
geo_basis: country; the notices read do not give a city
summary: MJS M&A Partners says a third party gained unauthorized access to its internal network. Its notice says some staff credentials were obtained and that, because logs for some period are missing, it cannot rule out leakage of customer, partner and M&A-material personal data, possibly affecting up to several thousand clients and partners. It says no successful login to the information server or data outflow is confirmed, and no ransomware.
plain: MJS M&A Partners says someone broke into its network and that client and partner data may have leaked, possibly up to several thousand firms. It says it has not confirmed any theft.
exec: An M&A adviser says client and partner data, including personal data in deal materials, may have leaked, with up to several thousand clients and partners possibly affected.
action: MJS M&A Partners advises customers and partners to be wary of suspicious emails or calls impersonating it, and not to open attachments or URLs in unexpected messages.

sources.name: MJS (Miroku Joho Service, parent company notice)

validation.note: The company's own notice and its parent's notice were read.

evidence.quote: 一部の期間の記録が残っていないため、情報が漏えいした可能性を否定できない状況です
対象となるお客様・お取引先は、最大で数千社です。
